up: Retrieve all IC50 activity records against the target CHEMBL4005. Return the following columns: compound chembl_id, canonical_smiles, assay chembl_id, assay description, assay_type, pubmed_id, and doi. Filter activities by standard_type = 'IC50' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4005'. Join activities with molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, assays, and docs. Do not apply a row limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, ass.description AS assay_description, ass.assay_type, d.pubmed_id, d.doi FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4005' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
